summary: Qualify and acquire Ascella cancellation and dimension-six transition data with science-first sample budgets and compatible iteration packing.

reconciliation.note: Canonical operators, live preflights, six acquired raw results, complete returned meshes, corrected simultaneous analysis, independent review and provider accounting agree within their stated boundaries.

scope: Prepare packed or separately ordered Ascella cancellation acquisitions, then a twelve-setting dimension-six pilot, with frozen scientific criteria, live readiness and bounded approval. Full-campaign expansion requires pilot qualification.
next_action: Prepare a separate case for mesh and physical-port residual diagnostics before broad acquisition.

resolution: All six scoped jobs completed and all seventeen settings were adjudicated. Cancellation passes, the twelve-setting pilot fails, and expansion stops under the frozen rule. Total consumption is 6.458752 credits and 57 execution seconds. A separate mechanism-diagnostic case is the next research question.
